About Our Guru

Sri Dr. Basavalinga Avadhoota

Sri Dr. Basavalinga Avadhoota is the Peethadhipati of the Mallayyagiri and Degalmadi Ashrams. Born Basavaraj Mulge on 11 July 1976 in Ratnapur, Telangana, he grew up in a cultured Lingayat family and was drawn to spiritual life from his student years.

He holds a postgraduate degree in Kannada and Philosophy with a gold medal from Karnataka University, and trained as a lab technician and homeopathy physician. After years of sadhana in the Himalayas, Kashi, Srishila and Rishikesh, he settled at Mallayyagiri in 2006 and dedicated his life to spiritual guidance and social service.
